title: The `due_date` property is always null on auto-billed invoices
summary: The due_date property is now always null on invoices with billing=charge_automatically.

migrationNotes.text: Provides you with a clear understanding of the invoice due_date behavior for auto-billed invoices. You can now reliably expect the due_date to be null in these scenarios, allowing for better handling and interpretation of the invoice data.

sources.quote: | [The `due_date` property is always null on auto-billed invoices](https://docs.stripe.com/changelog/2019-10-17/invoice-due-date-null.md) | Billing, Invoicing | Breaking | api |
The `due_date` property is now always null on invoices with `billing=charge_automatically`.
